cost.note: Project spend guardrail. tools/cost.py keeps the real ledger in .pmos/costs.jsonl (one record per worker run, priced from benchmarks.json) and checks it against budget_usd, approved at GATE 1. est_tokens_per_worker below is only the fallback for a role with no measured history yet; run 'cost.py calibrate' to replace it with a number this project actually measured.

embeddings.note: Offline by default: deterministic local hashing vectors. For real embeddings set env vars PMOS_EMBEDDINGS_URL (OpenAI-compatible /embeddings endpoint), PMOS_EMBEDDINGS_KEY, PMOS_EMBEDDINGS_MODEL, then run 'kb.py reindex-vectors'.
